title: Visual Release Asset Orchestrator: automated, brand-safe screenshot generation
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create an automated pipeline that produces release-ready onboarding and quickstart screenshots which are brand-consistent, privacy-compliant, and localization-safe. The pipeline should take render outputs or live UI snapshots and apply deterministic redaction, adaptive cropping for multiple aspect ratios (desktop, tablet, mobile), localized layout checks, contrast/accessibility verification, and attach metadata for docs and SDK examples.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline can ingest a UI render or URL and output 3 preset aspect ratios with brand overlays applied
Personal data redaction rules applied consistently and auditable (SSN, email patterns, API keys masked)
Localization margin map ensures no text truncation for 12 target languages
Golden diff check runs in CI and flags unexpected visual regressions
Outputs include JSON metadata describing masks, crop coordinates, localization-safe zones, and source version tags
design_notes: Use brand spacing and color tokens exported from the design system; do not hard-code hex values
Prefer vector overlays for badges and callouts so scaling across resolutions preserves sharpness
Create a mock data generator for onboarding flows so screenshots never expose real customer data
Define a small set of canonical viewports (1440x900, 1024x768, 390x844) for CI runs
Localization-safe zones should be defined per-component in a simple YAML spec stored alongside snapshots
implementation_steps: Design: define overlay library and redaction examples (mock data, blurred, black box)
Eng: add a snapshot hook to staging that exports full-page renders with DOM metadata
Eng: build a lightweight image pipeline service (lambda or job) to apply masks, crop, and run accessibility checks
CI: add golden-image comparison step and threshold rules; notify #design-assets on failures
Docs: integrate generated assets into quickstart pages with metadata-driven templating

decisions: Decision 2025-02-17: Use deterministic mask shapes (rounded rectangles) and a visibility taxonomy: masked, blurred, tokenized
Decision 2025-02-19: Store golden references in object storage with versioned keys rather than Git LFS to simplify CI throughput
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Localization overflow causing truncated CTA text. Mitigation: enforce 2-line safe zone for primary CTAs and run layout engine with longest-language mocks
Risk: PII leaks if snapshotting production. Mitigation: snapshot export only from staging and require token-based mTLS auth for pipeline
Risk: CI flakiness due to rendering timing. Mitigation: use DOM-to-image full render with explicit wait-for-network-idle hooks
